name: workflow-manager
description: Quality-first, context-efficient workflow management with adaptive routing, lossless output guidance, compaction recovery, and bounded subagent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Protect reasoning quality while managing context and agents.
interface.longDescription: Guides multi-step work without omitting required reasoning, evidence, correction, or verification; preserves oversized tool results for model reasoning; resumes acceptance state across compaction; and delegates only independent ready-now lanes.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow-manager to complete this task through the smallest relevant stages without omitting required reasoning, evidence, correction, or verification.
Correctness and acceptance evidence outrank context savings; preserve oversized results, checkpoint before compaction, and remove only redundant work or presentation.
Delegate only independent ready-now work: re-audit when a new non-overlapping read-only lane emerges, count the parent as one lane, and keep shared build/device chains serialized.
